name: Omakanvas
author: Erik Bourget
description: Canvas bar widget supporting multiple login methods, persisting your course information so you can ask your agents about it, and more.

barWidget.description: Student grades, teacher deadlines, and upcoming Canvas assignments.

schema.label: Canvas URL
schema.description: Your institution's Canvas origin, such as https://canvas.example.edu (without a course path).

schema.label: Use a password manager when signing in
schema.description: Sign in with a dedicated browser profile that keeps extensions such as 1Password. Install the extension there once; Canvas cookies are cleared after each sign-in.
